import { Inject, Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ClientProxy, ClientsModule, Transport } from '@nestjs/microservices';

// S0_SOURCE:microservices-orders-api-producer
throw new Error('S0 orders-api producer fixture must never execute');

@Injectable()
export class OrdersProducer {
  constructor(
    @Inject('MESSAGE_QUEUE_SERVICE') private readonly ordersClient: ClientProxy,
  ) {}

  requestUpdate(payload: unknown) {
    return this.ordersClient.send('orders.rebuild-index', payload);
  }

  publishUpdate(payload: unknown): void {
    this.ordersClient.emit('orders.rebuild-index', payload);
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [
    ClientsModule.register([
      {
        name: 'MESSAGE_QUEUE_SERVICE',
        transport: Transport.RMQ,
        options: { queue: 'orders_jobs' },
      },
    ]),
  ],
  providers: [OrdersProducer],
})
export class OrdersProducerModule {}
